Archie Pricing

What Archie costs.

Archie is in testing. These are the prices it will launch with, told to you now so there are no surprises later. See where it stands →

Plans

Two editions. Choose how to fund the AI.

Personal is for agents that answer one person; Business lets a team share them. Personal is free on an AI account of your own, with a limit of 20 jobs a day, and a plan takes the limit off; Business is a plan from the start. Personal also has an AI-included option, with the usage limits below. These are launch prices; paid signup is closed during testing.

Free
Freeno card

Two separate offers, neither asking for a card.

  • One agent, which is the one the app arrives with, answering you and nobody else
  • 14 days of everything, on our AI credits. Your agent thinks on our Claude account, so it works before you have signed up with an AI company yourself. It ends after the 14 days or when the credits run out
  • Or 20 jobs a day, with no end date. Paste a key from an AI company and Archie is free on that account, for as long as you like. Take it after the 14 days or instead of them. Personal only
  • Every add-on and every chat app, email and text reading need your own AI key. On our funded usage those reads are disabled; with your key, restart the agent to use them
  • Phone access needs a plan: your phone reaches the computer through our server, the part we pay for per message

While we are the ones paying, your messages pass through our server on the way to Anthropic; your own AI key bypasses that route from each agent’s next start. The credits are limited per computer and can be refused.

How the free tier works
Our pick For Personal
$30a month

Or $299 a year, which works out at $24.92 a month and saves you $61.

Or with the AI included, $59 a month.

  • Up to 10 agents on your own computer, each one answering you and nobody else
  • They run only while that computer is on, awake and connected to the internet. A laptop works if it stays plugged in with sleep set to Never; a time that passes while it is asleep is skipped, not run late
  • On the plain plan, your own AI account bills you directly, so the money never passes through us, and your conversations go straight to the AI company you picked, with no Otian server in the path
  • Every add-on in the store: skills, routines and personalities
  • All 5 chat apps: Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix, and iMessage on a Mac
  • Any of 7 AI companies, or any endpoint you name yourself
  • Archie keeps working even if Otian does not: our Terms require us to publish a final version with no license check, within 30 days
  • 14 days from first starting a plan to request a full refund

Cancel any time. A plan runs to the end of the period you have already paid for, and nothing on your computer is deleted when it ends.

Join the Waitlist
For Business
$99a month

Or $999 a year, which works out at $83.25 a month and saves you $189.

  • A separate app and a separate plan, not this one with extras: Archie for Business installs beside Archie with its own data and its own keys, and you buy whichever one fits
  • Any agent can answer your whole team, where a personal agent answers only its owner. That one difference is what the edition is for. No seat count and no per-person price: the plan is the plan
  • Add-ons built for a team, in this edition's store only: a handoff ledger the agent keeps from the team's own chat, a watch on what customers are still owed, and a morning standup that assembles both
  • Each person is answered from their own mail and calendar once they connect them, then the shared ones, and never from anybody else's
  • The owner decides who is in, with invite codes that expire in a day; anyone else is turned away before the agent reads a word
  • A guest talks freely without acting as the owner, until the owner turns the team up to full power
  • Up to 50 agents instead of 10, so a department can have its own and still share the ones everybody uses

Cancel any time. A plan runs to the end of the period you have already paid for, and nothing on your computer is deleted when it ends.

For Personal, with the AI included
$59a month

Or $599 a year. The plan above, plus $25 of Claude Sonnet usage every month, so there is no AI account to open and no second bill.

Join the Waitlist

Where it runs. On our Anthropic account, so what you write passes through our server. We keep no conversation content. Email and text reading need your own AI key; that key bypasses our conversation route from each agent’s next start.

When the $25 is used. Your agent pauses until next month refills it; nothing rolls over. Connect an AI account of your own at any point and it carries on from there, with nothing to switch.

Is $25 enough? Measured against real use: a light month fits several times over, a moderate month fits at the low end of its range, not the high, and a heavy month does not fit.

Running Archie yourself

Your plan, plus your AI usage.

On a plan with your own AI key, you pay Otian for the app and your provider for AI usage. Add-ons are included. Connected services may charge their own fees.

Personal, own AI key
$30a month

Or $299 a year, which saves $61. That is the plan above, and it is the one cost on this list that comes to us. Change it or stop it whenever you like.

Add-ons
Included

Every add-on in the store is included with Archie: skills, routines and personalities alike. None of them costs extra.

The AI Itself
Pay as you go

Your own account with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, xAI, DeepSeek or Mistral. It bills you directly, and the money never passes through us. Groq is cheapest, and its free tier cannot run Archie.

What that comes to →

The plan price is fixed; AI usage varies with how much your agents do. See measured estimates for three levels of use.

And if Archie can’t do something you need, we’ll build the add-on. That’s quoted per job, scoped and priced before any work starts. The result is yours, and it joins the marketplace, included with Archie for everyone after you.

Before you pay

2 ways to use Archie for nothing.

Neither one asks for a card, and the second one does not run out.

It writes nothing down, we keep no copy, and we use none of it for anything. Connect an AI account of your own and that stops from each agent’s next start.

On Our Account
Free creditsto start

The whole app, with nothing counted. Eligible accounts receive $2 of starter AI usage on our Claude account, expiring 14 days after the grant or when spent, whichever is first. Switching to your own key does not restart that clock.

We are paying, so we are in the path: the top lane above.

They are given per account, need a confirmed email address, are limited per computer, and can be refused.

On Your Own Account
20 jobsa day, free

Paste a key from an AI company and Archie opens, with no plan and no card. It is the whole app: every add-on, every routine, the mail watch. Free means 20 jobs a day, starting again at midnight, and five are kept for what you ask yourself, so an overnight routine cannot spend the day before you sit down. A separate offer from the trial, not what the trial becomes: take it after your 14 days or instead of them.

Your key is paying, so we are not in the path at all: the bottom lane.

You cover your own AI bill, which is why we can offer it: on the usage below, 20 jobs a day is a few dollars a month.

Which of the two you are on is on screen in the app, and every host is drawn on the Trust page.

The third cost, in numbers

What running the AI actually costs.

The AI account is yours and we take no cut of it, so we have no reason to be vague. Here is what one agent costs for a month, measured on real agents and priced at Anthropic’s rates as of September 12, 2026.

$140 a month

$1 to $2

a month at Economy, or $2 to $5 at Balanced

$21 to $42

a month at Economy, or $22 to $41 at Balanced

$64 to $132

a month at Economy, or $69 to $139 at Balanced

A range because two things move the bill that are not the message count: whether you send messages in sittings or spread them across the day, and the quality setting. An estimate: the real bill is on your AI company’s own dashboard.

Your agent spends in three places, and only one is you typing. The messages you send are two thirds to nine tenths of the bill. Reports it runs on a schedule are a tenth to a third: a dozen add-ons with their routines left on fire about 320 times a month. Mail it reads while you’re away is under a tenth, and the one part that carries on when you stop. And cost follows what you connect more than what you say: every connected service is described on every reply, so the same question costs about 2.8 times as much on a fully connected agent as on a bare one.

The full table, the inbox watch, and how we know
Measured monthly AI cost for one agent, at three levels of use and two response-quality settings.
How hard you work it What it’s connected to Messages sent a day Emails a day Per month at Economy Per month at Balanced
Light A calendar and a folder of documents about 6 none $1 to $2 $2 to $5
Moderate Calendar, email, a to-do list, and its own lists of people and projects about 25 about 80 $21 to $42 $22 to $41
Heavy All of those, plus about as many connections again about 70 about 200 $64 to $132 $69 to $139

Measured in August 2026 from real agents on a real key, over a 30-day month, and priced the way each part of it is billed as of September 12, 2026. The top of each range is priced the expensive way, with every reply starting from nothing, so a real month should land inside the range, not above it. On the moderate row the two columns are the same agent measured twice: its add-ons choose Balanced for themselves, so the dial moved only the inbox watch, and the Economy run happened to pull a bigger inbox, which is why its top end sits a dollar above. Read that row as one figure the dial does not move. The third quality setting, Best, costs more than Balanced and was not benched, so it is left out rather than guessed at. A shared Archie for Business agent answers a whole team on one bill.

Monthly cost of the inbox watch alone, by how many emails reach the agent.
Emails reaching your agent At Economy At Balanced At Balanced, writing drafts
30 a day $0.69 to $1.10 $1.39 to $2.20 $3.73 to $6.43
80 a day $1.85 to $2.93 $3.70 to $5.86 $9.94 to $17.14
200 a day $4.62 to $7.32 $9.24 to $14.64 $24.84 to $42.84

Already inside the totals above, shown on its own because it is the one part unrelated to how much you use your agent. Letting it write draft replies roughly triples it: a reply is a few hundred words of output, and output bills at 5x reading. That switch is on the Email panel.

The quality dial is a big control on a simple agent and a small one on a busy agent

An add-on can pick its own quality and ignore the dial, and most capable ones do, so the dial is worth whatever your agent has not already chosen for itself: the whole difference between $1 and $5 on the light row, under a tenth on the heavy row. The checkbox under it, “Use this for every skill”, overrides the add-ons and takes them off the level they chose. Measured on an agent with 12 add-ons, that checkbox takes about two thirds off the monthly cost.

Measured

The figures. Five bench runs in August 2026: four agent shapes, both quality settings, eight scripted turns each, on a real Anthropic key with a real calendar and inbox, every call’s bill read back. The size of the briefing, what each connection adds to it, the passes a message takes, and the text trimmed off an email before the model sees it are counted, not estimated.

Measured

The prices. Anthropic’s own price sheet, read on September 12, 2026. Claude Sonnet kept its launch price instead of rising on September 1, which is why every Balanced figure here is a third lower than it was in August. Nothing else moved.

Checked

The arithmetic. What a reply costs is one equation, kept with the Archie code, and in September 2026 it was run against two of our own agents in day-to-day use: 346 calls over two weeks on Claude, and 770 over three weeks on another company’s models. It reproduces every billed request in those logs to the cent.

Measured

How much the model works a problem through before answering, which bills at 5x reading: 6% to 9% of a message that starts a conversation, 39% to 50% of one sent mid-conversation.

Assumed

How you space your messages out, the biggest single number here. A message sent right after the last one costs about a sixth of one sent hours later, on every agent we measured. The logs also show a quarter of quick follow-ups on one agent paying the full price, so plan on the upper end of a range.

Assumed

How many messages a day, how often your schedule fires, and how much mail reaches your agent. The last is the widest: 30, 80 and 200 a day bracket what one real inbox did over two days.

Ongoing

We keep working on what a reply costs, and we do not publish how. Nobody here earns anything from this bill, and you should not pay more for a reply than it has to cost. A change reaches these figures once it has been measured, not before. One reply from a fully loaded agent is $0.01 when it follows another closely and up to $0.11 from nothing, at Balanced. Rented agents bill $0.04 to $0.10 an actionSource 1Source 2 or $2 a conversationSource 2 on their own price lists. Side by side →

Archie keeps its own running total on the Account screen, by AI company and by agent. It’s an estimate, not their invoice, and says so on screen. Until the next update it prices Claude’s Balanced model at the higher rate that never took effect, so on that setting it shows about half again more than the real bill. The real bill is on their dashboard, where you can set a hard spending cap.

Rather not set up alone?

Guided Setup

We build your first agent with you, and teach you to run it. The discovery call is free. Booking a session is optional and always has been: questions about Archie are answered by Jett or Jack within one business day at no charge, whether or not you ever pay us for an hour.

Guided Session
$250/session

Each session runs an hour. The rate never goes up because your setup is complicated. A bigger setup simply takes more sessions, and we tell you how many on the free discovery call.

Your Whole Setup, Quoted Free
No surprises

On the free 30-minute discovery call we scope how many sessions you need and give you the total up front. Archie’s plan and your AI account are separate costs, and we’ll walk you through both.

What Archie is worth

Put Archie next to the alternative.

The job you’re handing your agent is the one you’d otherwise hand a person.

Archie handles routine digital work. A human assistant brings judgment, relationships and work beyond your computer. Choose according to the job you need done.

Your agent doesn’t. It’s there at six in the morning and at eleven at night, for as long as your computer is on.

That’s the trade: tens of dollars a month rather than thousands a year, for help that never clocks out.

No surprises, and nothing to pay yet.
